source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
During your Shooting phase, whenever the thundercoil harpoon of this model is given a target:

1. Roll 1 D6 for that target and 1 D6 for every other enemy unit 6" or less from it.
2. Each unit whose roll is 4+ gets struck by arcing energies.
3. Once this model has resolved all its attacks on the target, every struck unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
